# Firefox
> Firefox is a free web browser from Mozilla focused on privacy, performance, and cross-platform browsing.

Firefox.com provides product information, downloads, release channels, privacy features, comparison pages, and links to Mozilla support, add-ons, and community resources.

## Downloads
- [Download Firefox](https://www.firefox.com/thanks/): Main Firefox download page for the latest recommended browser build.
- [Windows Download](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/download/windows/): Download Firefox for Windows with platform-specific installation guidance.
- [macOS Download](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/download/mac/): Download Firefox for macOS and view Mac installation details.
- [iOS Download](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/download/ios/): Get Firefox for iPhone and iPad from the App Store.
- [Android Download](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/download/android/): Get Firefox for Android and related mobile download information.
- [Linux Download](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/download/linux/): Download Firefox for Linux distributions and desktop environments.
- [Custom Download Options](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/download/all/): Access manual downloads for platforms, languages, and architectures.
- [Firefox ESR 64-bit](https://download.mozilla.org/?product=firefox-esr115-latest-ssl&os=win64&lang=en-US): Direct download for the latest Firefox Extended Support Release build.

## Browsers
- [Desktop Browser](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/browsers/desktop/): Overview of Firefox for desktop, features, and download options.
- [Mobile Browser](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/browsers/mobile/): Overview of Firefox for mobile devices across iOS and Android.
- [Firefox for Business](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/browsers/enterprise/): Enterprise-focused Firefox information for organizational deployment and management.
- [Compare Browsers](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/compare/): Compare Firefox with other major web browsers and platforms.
- [Learn More](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/more/): Explore broader Firefox product information and educational resources.

## Features
- [Firefox Features](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/features/): Central overview of Firefox privacy, security, and productivity features.
- [Fingerprint Blocking](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/features/block-fingerprinting/): Explains Firefox protections against browser fingerprinting techniques.
- [Ad Tracker Blocking](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/features/adblocker/): Describes Firefox protections that block ad trackers and related tracking.
- [Private Browsing Mode](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/features/private-browsing/): Overview of Firefox private browsing and privacy-focused browsing controls.
- [Password Manager](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/features/password-manager/): Introduces Firefox’s built-in password management and credential-saving tools.
- [Data Protection](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/user-privacy/): Explains Mozilla’s approach to user privacy and data protection.

## Release Channels
- [Release Notes](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/firefox/notes/): Official Firefox release notes for current and past browser versions.
- [Desktop Channels](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/channel/desktop/): Overview of Firefox release channels for testing and development.
- [Nightly](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/channel/desktop/#nightly): Information about the earliest Firefox testing channel with daily builds.
- [Beta](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/channel/desktop/#beta): Information about Firefox Beta for pre-release testing and feedback.
- [Developer Edition](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/channel/desktop/developer/): Firefox Developer Edition for web developers and advanced testing workflows.
- [Unsupported Windows Notice](https://support.mozilla.org/kb/firefox-users-windows-7-8-and-81-moving-extended-support): Support article for users on older unsupported Windows versions.

## Support and Help
- [Firefox Support](https://support.mozilla.org/): Official Mozilla support portal for Firefox help articles and troubleshooting.
- [Connect](https://connect.mozilla.org/): Mozilla feedback and idea-sharing platform for Firefox users.
- [Community](https://community.mozilla.org/): Mozilla community hub for participation, events, and contributor programs.
- [Contribute](https://www.mozilla.org/contribute/): Ways to contribute to Mozilla and support Firefox development.

## Extensions and Ecosystem
- [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/): Official marketplace for Firefox extensions, themes, and browser customizations.
- [Firefox Blog](https://blog.mozilla.org/en/category/firefox/): Mozilla blog category covering Firefox news, releases, and product updates.
- [Firefox Podcasts](https://www.youtube.com/@firefox/podcasts): Firefox podcast content and related video discussions on YouTube.

## Product Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.firefox.com/): Main Firefox product homepage with downloads and feature highlights.
- [Features Overview](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/features/): Product-level overview of key Firefox capabilities and protections.
- [Desktop Product Page](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/browsers/desktop/): Desktop-focused product page for Firefox browser users.
- [Mobile Product Page](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/browsers/mobile/): Mobile-focused product page for Firefox on phones and tablets.
- [Enterprise Product Page](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/browsers/enterprise/): Product page for business and enterprise Firefox deployments.
